FILE: cortical/reasoning/thought_graph.py lines 472-503

SOLUTION: Use path.append/pop with visited set, no copies

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- All tests pass: pytest tests/unit/test_thought_graph.py -v
- 1000-node graph cycle detection <1s

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Change return type or signature
- Modify find_bridges()
- Break existing tests

VERIFY: pytest tests/unit/test_thought_graph.py -v -k cycle
